	icon = focus_generic_industry_investment
	x = -2
	y = 7
	relative_position_id = COLDWAR_NORDIC_helsinki_framework
	cost = 5
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
	prerequisite = { focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_smaller_firms }
	joint_trigger = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_participant = yes }
	available = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_can_start = yes }
	cancel_if_invalid = yes
	continue_if_invalid = no
	select_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_can_start = yes OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_smaller_firms } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_busy = yes } }
				SWE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading }
				NRY = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading }
				DEN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading }
				FIN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading }
				ICE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading }
			}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_commissioned
		}
	}
	complete_tooltip = {
		add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network bonus = 0.40 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
	}
	completion_reward_joint_originator = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_earned } }
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network bonus = 0.40 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_earned
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_leading }
		}
	}
	completion_reward_joint_member = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_commissioned COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_frozen = yes COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_ready = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_earned } }
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network bonus = 0.40 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_industrial_network_earned
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
}

joint_focus = {
	id = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk
	icon = scientific_exchange
	x = 2
	y = 2
	relative_position_id = COLDWAR_NORDIC_helsinki_framework
	cost = 3
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_RESEARCH }
	prerequisite = { focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_helsinki_framework }
	joint_trigger = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_participant = yes }
	available = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_can_start = yes }
	cancel_if_invalid = yes
	continue_if_invalid = no
	select_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_can_start = yes OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_helsinki_framework } }
			COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_lock_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_busy = yes } }
				SWE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading }
				NRY = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading }
				DEN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading }
				FIN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading }
				ICE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading }
			}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_commissioned
		}
	}
	complete_tooltip = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_effect_tt
	}
	completion_reward_joint_originator = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_earned } }
				custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_effect_tt
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_earned
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_leading }
		}
	}
	completion_reward_joint_member = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_commissioned COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_frozen = yes COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_ready = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_earned } }
				custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_effect_tt
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk_earned
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
}

joint_focus = {
	id = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange
	icon = scientific_exchange
	x = 1
	y = 3
	relative_position_id = COLDWAR_NORDIC_helsinki_framework
	cost = 4
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_RESEARCH }
	prerequisite = { focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk }
	mutually_exclusive = { focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_protected_research }
	joint_trigger = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_participant = yes }
	available = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_can_start = yes }
	cancel_if_invalid = yes
	continue_if_invalid = no
	select_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_can_start = yes OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_desk } }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_route_1
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_busy = yes } }
				SWE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading }
				NRY = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading }
				DEN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading }
				FIN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading }
				ICE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading }
			}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_commissioned
		}
	}
	complete_tooltip = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_programme }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_research_speed_factor = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_research_speed_factor_tt }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_drift_defence_factor = -0.10 tooltip = drift_defence_factor_tt }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 tooltip = education_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt }
	}
	completion_reward_joint_originator = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_earned } }
				hidden_effect = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_programme } } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_drift_defence_factor } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_drift_defence_factor = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_education_cost_multiplier_modifier } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_production_speed_offices_factor } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_production_speed_offices_factor = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_research_speed_factor } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_research_speed_factor = 0 } }
						add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_programme }
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_programme }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_research_speed_factor = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_research_speed_factor_tt }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_drift_defence_factor = -0.10 tooltip = drift_defence_factor_tt }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 tooltip = education_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt }
				force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_earned
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_leading }
		}
	}
	completion_reward_joint_member = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_commissioned COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_frozen = yes COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_ready = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_earned } }
				hidden_effect = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_programme } } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_drift_defence_factor } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_drift_defence_factor = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_education_cost_multiplier_modifier } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_production_speed_offices_factor } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_production_speed_offices_factor = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_research_speed_factor } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_research_speed_factor = 0 } }
						add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_programme }
					}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_programme }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_research_speed_factor = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_research_speed_factor_tt }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_drift_defence_factor = -0.10 tooltip = drift_defence_factor_tt }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_research_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.02 tooltip = education_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt }
				force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_open_exchange_earned
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
}

	id = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience
	icon = water_conservation
	x = 7
	y = 3
	relative_position_id = COLDWAR_NORDIC_helsinki_framework
	cost = 4
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
	prerequisite = { focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_cross_border_services }
	mutually_exclusive = { focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_mainland_power }
	joint_trigger = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_participant = yes }
	available = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_can_start = yes }
	cancel_if_invalid = yes
	continue_if_invalid = no
	select_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_can_start = yes OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_NORDIC_cross_border_services } }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_route_2
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_busy = yes } }
				SWE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_leading }
				NRY = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_leading }
				DEN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_leading }
				FIN = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_leading }
				ICE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_leading }
			}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_leading
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_commissioned
		}
	}
	complete_tooltip = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_programme }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_repair_speed_infrastructure_factor = 0.10 tooltip = repair_speed_infrastructure_factor_tt }

		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_leading COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_national_resilience_earned } }
				hidden_effect = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_programme } } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_energy_use_multiplier } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_energy_use_multiplier = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_mobilization_speed } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_mobilization_speed = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_naval_detection } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_naval_detection = 0 } }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_navy_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_navy_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 } }

						add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_programme }
					}

				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_repair_speed_infrastructure_factor = 0.10 tooltip = repair_speed_infrastructure_factor_tt }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 tooltip = bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt }
				force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes

			}

		}
